ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high-intensity (white) localized ratio of approximately 98:2.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A single, high-contrast contiguous white patch is located at the center-top margin, immediately left of the median notch. The remainder of the fluke presents as a uniform low-intensity dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree vertex angle relative to the horizontal fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is relatively smooth with minor irregular indentations; right lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate-frequency serrations and a jagged terminus at the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with slightly concave trailing edges tapering to sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast white/grey textured pixels at the distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular tissue loss or heavy scarring at the terminal end of the right fluke lobe, creating a ragged edge profile compared to the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific isolated white pigmentation patch located at the interior dorsal-ventral transition of the left lobe near the notch.
